easy.q: How many animated Moana feature films has Disney released?
easy.fact: Moana 2 earned more than $1 billion worldwide after its 2024 release.

easy.q: How many countries are known as the Baltic states?
easy.fact: They are Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania.

easy.q: How many holes does a golfer play in a standard four-round PGA Tour event?
easy.fact: Players who miss the cut after 36 holes go home early.

easy.q: How many years did Europe's Thirty Years' War last?
easy.fact: It ran from 1618 to 1648 and ended with the Peace of Westphalia.

easy.q: How many squares are on a standard checkerboard?
easy.fact: Each player starts with 12 checkers on the dark squares.

medium.q: How many cents did a first-class Forever stamp cost when it debuted in 2007?
medium.fact: A Forever stamp stays valid for first-class postage no matter how much rates rise.

medium.q: How many Super Bowls has Travis Kelce won with the Kansas City Chiefs?
medium.fact: The Chiefs won Super Bowls LIV, LVII and LVIII.

medium.q: How many counties does Delaware have?
medium.fact: They are New Castle, Kent and Sussex, the fewest of any state.

medium.q: How many seasons did the sitcom New Girl run?
medium.fact: Zooey Deschanel starred as Jess from 2011 to 2018.

medium.q: Counting the goalie, how many players per team are in the pool at once in water polo?
medium.fact: Water polo has been an Olympic sport since 1900.

hard.q: Novak Djokovic holds the record for most weeks ranked world No. 1 in men's tennis. How many weeks?
hard.fact: Steffi Graf held the overall record of 377 weeks until Djokovic passed her in 2023.

hard.q: In what year did Tchaikovsky's ballet The Nutcracker premiere in St. Petersburg?
hard.fact: It opened on Dec. 18, but became a U.S. holiday staple only in the 1950s.

hard.q: To the nearest foot, how tall is Oregon's Mount Hood?
hard.fact: It is the highest point in Oregon and one of the Cascade Range's volcanoes.

hard.q: How many episodes of Fleabag were made in total?
hard.fact: Phoebe Waller-Bridge wrote and starred in both six-episode seasons.
